notes.title: Patch 1.0.7
notes.content:
[list]
[*] It is now easier to tell to what slot an equipment fits (such slot is now highlighted when hovering over an equipment)
[*] Fixed some typos in Guidebook and inaccuracies in Epilogue story
[*] The values in the Intelligence Test in the tutorial have been corrected
[/list]

If you haven't played for a while [b]here are the most important changens made since the release[/b]. Most of them have been added thanks to the help of players.
[list]
[*] There's almost no grind in the game. You can finish most levels without being forced to finish previous ones 
[*] Runnic Eggs can be exchanged for Dragon Eggs at merchant (2 for 1)
[*] Crystallite can be exchanged at The Witch (2 Crystallite of one color for 1 Crystallite of another color)
[*] Traps are dealing more damage so they can't be ignored any more
[*] Many minor bugs have also been fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
- Crystal power bonuses from objects and events is now increased as the game progresses
- Fixed a bug with the "Charge" skill that dealt the same damage on both level 3 and level 4 of the skill
- removed an invisible obstacle in the 2nd room of the Scorched Forest 2

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
- you can now exchange Crystallite at The Witch (2 Crystallite of one color for 1 Crystallite of another color)
- an enemy is selected as a target automatically if it's the only one left (so you don't have to click it at the beginning of every move)
- fixed some spelling errors in english and polish versions

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
- fixed a bug where some slots were busy even though there were no items in them. 
This bug was caused by selling an item by dragging it on the "Sell" button. The intended way is to just click "Sell" button and then choose items to sell. 

- increased damage done by traps (it was definetly too low)

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
- you can now exchange Runnic Eggs for Dragon Eggs at merchant (2 for 1)
- changed icon of boots slot for the sake of consistency (trousers icon could be misleading)
- adjusted difficulty so there shouldn't be difficulty spikes

I've noticed that some of you have issues with some equipment slots being busy even though there are items in them. I'm working on fixing this issue today.

Please message me if you notice there's too much grind in the game. (which I want to avoid)
You can do it by starting a thread in community hub or by sending me an email (contact@mrealms.com). You can also join the Discord channel

notes.title: Balance Patch (1.0.2)
notes.content:
After getting initial feedback I'm making some balance changes
- reduced health and attack of enemies on later levels
- increased number of potions available at merchant
- decreased price of level 1 and 2 potions at merchant 
- increased starting health of the heroes (by 4)

notes.title: Balance Patch (1.0.1)
notes.content: Looks like the game was a bit too difficult on later levels. I don't want it to become tedious grind so I'm reducing health and attack of some enemies.

notes.title: Game is now available!
notes.content:
After 1,5 years of hard work I can finally anounce, that my game Mysterious Realms RPG is now ready to play! I think it's not time for long descriptions. 
Just have fun! :)

notes.title: Closed beta tests are over!
notes.content:
So after 4 weeks of testing almost every bug has been fixed. I've spent many hours tinkering with code to make the game most enjoyable and basing on feedback received, I think I succeded. There will be no delays - Mysterious Realms RPG is going live on 25 October! :)

If you want to show Mysterious Realms RPG on your stream or youtube video, just message me: contact@mrealms.com
I'm sure we can work something out.

And here is an updated version of the trailer
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FG4YLQBGY98

notes.title: Mysterious Realms - Status of works as on May 2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31194223/e108bcfb01c2809d93fba4b04d9e20e054bcbb04.png[/img]

The environment of all three zones have been finished. I also have almost finished creating all the regular enemies, events and equipment. In the following weeks I'm going to work on bosses, saves and sound. 

Unfortunately I will not be able to make it in time, so the release date is being postponed to September/October. Nevertheless, I am convinced that this is the ultimate term. In the meantime you may want to check the updated store page!
